Welcome to the Somananda Tantra School YouTube channel!

Our founders – Somananda himself & Liisa Maimon – and the rest of Somananda’s experienced tantra teachers and tantra practitioners, have created this channel just for YOU; so whatever stage you’re at on your tantra yoga journey, we’ve got wonderful tantra videos and tantra yoga practice and spirituality playlist series that will delight and inform.

From tantra 101, tantric sex & sexuality and on through tantra massage and tantric meditation we’ve got you covered. The aim of this channel to bring the joy of authentic tantra yoga and tantra practices to the world, so whether it’s Tantra for men or tantra for women you’re looking for, tantra yoga teacher training or the very best tantra retreats at our spectacular Nicaraguan rainforest basecamp – whatever it is you’re seeking we hope you’ll find it here.

Please subscribe, turn on all notifications and comment freely – we love to hear from you!
